setting.gitPro.logging.level.description: Git Pro operation metadata logging; credentials are always redacted.
setting.gitPro.confirmBeforePush.descrip: Confirm pushes to the configured upstream.
setting.gitPro.protectedBranches.descrip: Branches that ask before you commit on them, push them, force push them or delete them. Glob patterns: * is within one path segment (release/*), ** crosses segments, ? is one character. Empty by default.
setting.gitPro.remoteHosts.description: Hosts that Open on Remote and the #123 links of History should know besides github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org and codeberg.org. Name the host and its kind: { "git.example.com": "gitlab" }. The kinds are github, gitlab, bitbucket and gitea (also Forgejo). Empty by default.
setting.gitPro.pull.strategy.description: Pull strategy. Divergence requires an explicit merge or rebase choice.
The types offered under Conventional Commits in the commit box's menu: feat, fix and so on. Choosing one writes `type(scope)!: ` at the start of the message's first line. Empty hides the choice.
setting.gitPro.commit.messageHistoryLimi: Maximum messages stored per repository in workspace state.
setting.gitPro.autoFetch.enabled.descrip: Periodically fetch repository remotes. Authentication is handled by built-in Git.
setting.gitPro.autoFetch.intervalMinutes: Auto-fetch interval with exponential backoff after failures.
setting.gitPro.blame.enabled.description: Show author and commit for the active line. Dirty editor buffers are not attributed from disk.
setting.gitPro.codeLens.enabled.descript: Show a read-only File History CodeLens on saved files in open trusted repositories. No automatic Git read.
setting.gitPro.blame.delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before reading active-line blame. Dirty buffers never receive disk attribution.
setting.gitPro.graph.pageSize.descriptio: Commits read per history page; loaded graph remains bounded at 2000 commits.
extension.description: Review changes, commit, browse History, compare branches, resolve merge conflicts and recover a stopped rebase from one Git sidebar.
setting.gitPro.changes.groupBy.descripti: Display paths directly or as folders within each staged/working/untracked/conflict group.
setting.gitPro.cli.readTimeout.descripti: Local CLI read timeout in seconds. Built-in Git API requests use their own host behavior.
setting.gitPro.cli.timeout.description: Local CLI mutation timeout in seconds. Interruption may leave Git state changed; inspect before retrying.
setting.gitPro.cli.networkTimeout.descri: Explicit CLI remote operation timeout in seconds. Does not cancel built-in Git API fetch/push.

setting.gitPro.conflicts.autoOpen.descri: When to open the Conflicts tab. Opening it never changes files.
setting.gitPro.conflicts.autoOpen.gitPro: Open it when a Git Pro merge, pull, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or stash stops on conflicts.
setting.gitPro.conflicts.autoOpen.always: Also open it in the background, without taking focus, when conflicts appear from Git run elsewhere, such as a terminal merge.
setting.gitPro.conflicts.autoOpen.never: Never open it automatically. The Changes banner, badge and notification still appear.
setting.gitPro.conflicts.groupByDirector: Group conflicted files by directory in the Conflicts tab.
Which file changes a branch comparison lists first.
Since fork: what the compared branch changed since it diverged (from the merge base).
Tip to tip: the direct difference between the two branch tips.
color.gitPro.accent.description: Git Pro accent for the current branch and HEAD in History, the merge base and an in-progress rebase. Webviews read it as --vscode-gitPro-accent.

capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Git Pro requires trust before reading Git configuration or running Git.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Git Pro requires a filesystem and Git executable.
